function.name: MAP_NAME
function.param: Number of graphs inside of library
function.abstract: It returns the name of a graph

description.p: All graph has a name which can have up to 32 characters, that can be recovered by this function, or be changed by . This name is specially useful when a graph is inside of a FPG library, because this graph has two identifiers: a number and his name that allow to distinguish it of other graph which is also inside of the FPG library.
